name: cf0-zero
description: Zero is your firm's AI property manager in cf0. Hand it follow-ups with tenants, guests and owners by email, approve each email before it goes out, and pay per completed task.

interface.longDescription:
Zero is an AI property manager, an AI employee that works inside cf0 for property management, lettings and short-term rental firms. This plugin lets your team hand Zero its follow-ups from chat, and Zero keeps the work on your firm's task board in cf0.

Ask Zero what it is handling, what is waiting on you and where a task stands. Asking also reads your homes and their listing requirements. It changes nothing and contacts no one.

Hand Zero the follow-ups your team would otherwise chase by email: arranging access with a tenant for a repair, confirming a check-out time with a guest, or telling an owner about booked work. Each task is about one person on your firm's records. Zero plans it and drafts an email from your firm's own Zero mailbox. Someone at your firm previews and approves the email, in chat or on cf0.ai, and nothing is sent before that. Zero then sends it, reads the reply and closes the task once the person confirms. If they suggest a different time or ask something only your team can answer, Zero asks you first and drafts its reply for your approval.

give_agent_task takes maintenance and access, move-out and turnover, owner updates and stay operations. That task tool does not take leasing, leads, cold outreach, marketing, tenant screening, rent or arrears, payments, legal notices or emergencies. People on your records appear as reference codes with their role, and their contact details and access codes stay hidden. Zero never takes a phone number, and it reaches people by email only. Zero adds someone new from chat only after you agree to their name, email, role and property. Messages to 10 or more people, documents and sensitive content can only be approved on cf0.ai.

Setup takes minutes on cf0.ai: an admin finishes your firm's setup, cf0 gives Zero an email address for your firm, and your team adds the people Zero emails, on cf0.ai or from chat.

Owners can prepare home drafts. The firm's named admin approver can approve or decline ready homes. Rent and deposit come only from the owner's exact words. Ownership proof, photo rights and lettings terms stay on cf0.ai.

In chat, Zero reaches people by email only. It does not answer your firm's phone line, WhatsApp or inbox, and it does not run guest agents.
defaultPrompt: What is waiting on me from Zero today?
Ask Zero to arrange access with the tenant at Harbour View Flat 3 for the boiler service on Friday morning.

positive.description: What is waiting on the user. Reads the firm's work without changing anything.
positive.prompt: What is waiting on me from Zero today?
positive.expected_behavior: Zero lists what waits on the user: the email to the guest at Seafront Studio 2 with its preview, Zero's question about the Elm Court 5 owner update, and the Elm Court notice to 15 people, shown without its message and with a link to cf0. The open tasks appear with their state. People appear as reference codes (p_...) with their role, and no name, email address or phone number appears. Nothing changes and no one is contacted.

positive.description: Hand Zero one task about one person on the firm's records.
positive.prompt: Ask Zero to arrange access with the tenant at Harbour View Flat 3 for the boiler service on Friday morning.
positive.expected_behavior: The result is accepted, with a task id, Zero's plan and a note that nothing is sent until someone at the firm approves Zero's email. The task appears on the board at cf0.ai/app/tasks. The same prompt again on the same day returns already_given with the same task id, and no second task appears.

positive.description: Preview, then approve, an ordinary email to one person. Two turns: this prompt, then "Approve it."
positive.prompt: Show me the email Zero wants to send the guest at Seafront Studio 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows the preview: the recipient's role (guest) and reference code, the property, the send time in the firm's time zone (Europe/London) and the full message, with the guest's name and contact details replaced by the reference code. Turn 2, "Approve it.", approves with the item id and version code from turn 1 and returns done. cf0 records the approval as made from the assistant, and Zero sends the email on cf0's next send run, within 10 minutes.

positive.description: Answer a question Zero asked about a task.
positive.prompt: Zero has a question about the owner update for Elm Court 5. Tell it Friday afternoon works for us.
positive.expected_behavior: ask_agent finds Zero's question with the owner's reply proposing Friday afternoon. answer_agent answers it with approve and the user's words and returns done. Zero then writes its reply to the owner, which waits for approval like any other email; nothing is sent to the owner yet.

positive.prompt: Cancel the gutter cleaning task at Riverside 7.
positive.expected_behavior: ask_agent finds the Riverside 7 task and its version code. answer_agent cancels it and returns done. The task shows as cancelled on cf0.ai/app/tasks and Zero sends nothing further about it.

positive.description: Read the listing requirements for England.
positive.prompt: What do I need to list a flat in England?
positive.expected_behavior: ask_agent reads market GB-ENG and shows the listing requirements. It does not suggest a rent or deposit. Nothing changes.

positive.description: Prepare a home draft from the owner's words.
positive.prompt: List my 2-bed in Manchester, rent is £1,200 pcm
positive.expected_behavior: list_home stages a draft. rent_owner_text stays exactly £1,200 pcm. The result names missing details. The home is not published.

positive.description: Show a ready home, then approve it with its current id and version.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a ready home in the matching backend release. ask_agent shows its summary and current version. After the named admin approver says Approve it, answer_agent returns done and the home shows as listed. A repeat returns already_answered and records no second decision.

negative.description: Leads and marketing. Zero takes no leads, cold outreach or marketing, and one person per task. The assistant declines, or give_agent_task returns refused: "Zero only takes maintenance and access, move-out and turnover, owner updates and stay operations ... Nothing was created." No task appears and no email is sent.
negative.prompt: Email these 40 Zillow leads about our new listing and book them in for viewings.

negative.description: A raw phone number. Zero never takes a phone number typed into the chat, and it reaches people by email only. The assistant asks for the person's name on the firm's records, or give_agent_task returns refused. No task is created and no message is sent.
negative.prompt: Text +44 7700 900123 and arrange access for the boiler repair next week.

negative.description: A message to 15 people. Messages to 10 or more people can only be approved by someone at the firm on cf0.ai. ask_agent shows the notice as waiting with the number of people and a link, without the message; answer_agent returns needs_cf0 with an open_in_cf0 link. The notice stays pending and no resident receives anything.
negative.prompt: Approve Zero's lift maintenance notice to the 15 Elm Court residents.

negative.description: The assistant must not suggest or calculate a rent. It asks for the rent the user chooses.
The assistant must not add a tenant rule as a home fact. Tenant rules go in the home's criteria on cf0.ai.

review.commerce_description: Zero sells nothing in the chat: it states no price, starts no subscription, links to no checkout and takes no payment.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.0 adds home drafts and listing decisions. Read listing requirements, prepare a draft from your own details, and approve or decline a ready home. Ownership proof, photo rights and terms stay on cf0.ai.
